claim: All 41 original-Xbox solo segments preserve one manifest-bound player start and the complete source player/teleport entity topology with zero port regression.

inputs.source_binding: Each overlay manifest's decoded source MAP SHA-256

decision.reason: Every player entity is identical to the manifest-hash-matched decoded Xbox source. Unreferenced records are retained rather than deleted without runtime evidence.

limits: Static topology does not prove native player placement, collision clearance, teleport timing, target side effects or save/load restoration.
The three unreferenced teleport destinations may still have a dynamic engine/script path outside exact MAP links and direct $name source expressions.
The Monorail 2 deathmatch entity is authenticated source residue and is not evidence of an active solo route.
